metadata.description: Plugin marketplace mirroring select skill sources from this repo that ship as full Claude Code plugins (hooks, commands, and/or skills) upstream, vendored here from their original repos.

plugins.name: headroom
plugins.description: Headroom startup hooks for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Forces the laziest solution that works. YAGNI, stdlib first, one line over fifty.

plugins.name: claude-mem
plugins.description: Memory compression system for Claude Code - persist context across sessions.

plugins.name: ecc
plugins.description: Harness-native ECC plugin for engineering teams - agents, skills, legacy command shims, reusable hooks, rules, MCP conventions, and operator workflows for Claude Code plus adjacent agent harnesses.

plugins.name: obsidian
plugins.description: Create and edit Obsidian vault files including Markdown, Bases, and Canvas. Use when working with .md, .base, or .canvas files in an Obsidian vault.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Automated code review for pull requests using multiple specialized agents with confidence-based scoring.
